title: Disputed Self-Pay Estimates — The Undisputed Part in Medical Hardship Documentation
content:
The undisputed part of a bill under dispute is added to the qualifying medical debt Riverbend documents for its own charges under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care).

The disputed estimate is the patient's Good Faith & Price Estimates self-pay good faith estimate (single scheduled service, procedure with co-providers, or recurring course of care, in that order, and within one variant the estimate listed first among the patient's estimates) that is in dispute; its expected charges are the convening-facility and convening-professional lines of its current version. For the disputed estimate's linked Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account, its window postings are those for which fewer than twelve whole months separate the posting date from the documentation day, a whole month running from a day of one month to the same day of the next month or, when the next month has no such day, to the first day of the month after it; that account's amounts-generally-billed share is the program's amounts-generally-billed percentage (34.6 percent on every tier) of its self-pay final-bill liabilities in that window, rounded half-up to the cent.

| Linked account of the disputed estimate | Added |
|---|---|
| coded emergency or medically necessary | the smaller of its expected charges and that account's amounts-generally-billed share |
| coded elective | its expected charges |
| no estimate in dispute | nothing |

Hypothetical: expected charges 2,000.00; final-bill liabilities in the window 5,000.00, so the share is 1,730.00. On an emergency account 1,730.00 is added; on an elective account 2,000.00 is added.
